اهتلكتن (form VIII)
# اِهْتَلَكْتُنَّ (ihtalaktunna) /ih.ta.lak.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اُهْتُلِكْتُنَّ (uhtuliktunna) /uh.tu.lik.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
